message.content:
**Pantone “Sky Blue”**

The most widely recognized Pantone reference for a true sky‑blue hue is:

| Pantone System | Code | Description | Hex (approx.) |
|----------------|------|-------------|---------------|
| Pantone Fashion, Home & Interiors | **14‑4318** | *Sky Blue* | #87CEEB |

> **Why 14‑4318?**  
> Pantone’s “Sky Blue” (14‑4318) is the standard color used in the Pantone Fashion, Home & Interiors (FHI) system. It’s the shade that most designers, printers, and manufacturers refer to when they say “sky blue.”  

### Other Pantone “Sky Blue” Variants

| Pantone System | Code | Notes |
|----------------|------|-------|
| Pantone Matching System (PMS) | **PMS 290** | A lighter, more pastel sky blue often used in graphic design. |
| Pantone Color Bridge | **PMS 290 C** | The CMYK equivalent of PMS 290. |
| Pantone 2019 Color of the Year (Living Coral) | **PMS 16-1546** | Not a sky blue, but sometimes confused with “sky” due to its name. |

### Quick Reference

- **Pantone 14‑4318** – *Sky Blue* (FHI) – Hex #87CEEB  
- **Pantone PMS 290** – *Sky Blue* (PMS) – Hex #B2E0FF  
- **Pantone PMS 290 C** – *Sky Blue* (PMS) – Hex #B2E0FF  

If you’re working on a project that requires a specific Pantone reference, it’s best to confirm the exact system (FHI vs. PMS) and the intended use (print, digital, textile, etc.). The hex values above are approximate conversions for digital use.
